strings.airspaceAltitudeSettingsForceGpsLegend: Some competitions require use of GPS altitude for measuring airspace infringements. When selected, all airspace height calculations (AMSL, flight level) are considered to be GPS altitude instead of pressure altitude.
strings.liveEnabledSummary: Livetrack na live.xcontest.org. Savjet: Trajanje baterije možete uštedjeti omogućavanjem automatskog rukovanja glavnom sinkronizacijom u integraciji sa sustavom Android.
strings.livePrefClaimDescr: 1 minute after landing the flight is claimed to XContest. To avoid littering XContest with hikes etc., the tracklogs that do not appear to be flights are ignored. If that happens, you can still claim your flight from flight details.
strings.livePrefTempDisabledSummary: Tap or restart XCTrack to enable position sharing.
strings.prefFAIComplianceDescription: For FAI CIVL compliance you have to use internal sensors only. An internal pressure sensor is required and force location api for GPS has to be disabled.
strings.prefFirstRunWizardAgainSummary: Show first run wizard again during next start of XCTrack
strings.prefGliderRefreshSummary: If you can't find your glider try refreshing the list from xcontest.org.
strings.prefKeyBindingsMapPanDown: Pan map DOWN in panning mode
strings.prefKeyBindingsMapPanLeft: Pan map LEFT in panning mode
strings.prefKeyBindingsMapPanRight: Pan map RIGHT in panning mode
strings.prefKeyBindingsMapPanUp: Pan map UP in panning mode
strings.prefKeyBindingsNextWaypoint: Prijedi na sljedecu tocku u zadatku
strings.prefKeyBindingsPrevWaypoint: Vracanje na prethodnu tocku u zadatku
strings.prefKeyBindingsProximityScreenOnSummary: Proximity sensor turns on powered-off screen
strings.prefSensorsAcousticVarioCustomProfileEna: Use custom sound profile for acoustic vario.
strings.prefSensorsAcousticVarioNotice: Acoustic vario is usable only when a pressure sensor is available (internal or external): see Connection & Sensors.
strings.prefSensorsAcousticWarnUnavailable: Warn if baro data not available
strings.prefSensorsAddSensorDescription: Here you can add another sensor and then sort them by priority. If any sensor fails, next one available in the list will be used.
strings.prefSensorsQnhAutoUpdateSummary: Set QNH so that pressure altitude matches GPS altitude on the ground.
strings.prefShareALogFileDesc: Send us a log file if you run into an issue
strings.prefSoundEventsDescription: Tap an event to customize its sound, spoken message and on-screen notification. You can turn it on and off completely with the switch.
strings.prefTestingDownloadTranslationsSummary: Preuzmi najnoviju XCTrack razvojnu verziju sa novim jezicnim prijevodima.
strings.prefTestingExternalSensorLogDescription: Write data from external sensor into debug log
strings.prefTestingInternalSensorLogDescription: Write data from internal sensor into debug log
strings.prefTestingLastExitsSummary: Time and reason of the last times XCTrack was terminated unexpectedly (crashes and system kills). Normal exits via the menu are not listed.
strings.prefTestingLogDescription: Create debug log files in XCTrack/Log directory
strings.prefTestingManualTakeoffSum: Override take off detection and manually trigger the takeoff event.
strings.prefTestingOEMReprocessBootstrapsSummary: Process bootstrap files again during next start. This can modify your settings. Export settings before finishing the app.
strings.prefTweakAnnounceEventsByIntentsDescript: Allow the app to broadcast flight events (e.g., takeoff, landing) so other apps can respond.
strings.prefTweakAudioFocusDescription: Allows using the bluetooth headset buttons
strings.prefTweakBlockKeysDescription: Onemogući većinu tipki uređaja za operativni sustav.
strings.prefTweakDisableNotifDescription: Some phones are buggy (Xiaomi) and periodic updating system notification (GPS+Live status, airtime) can reset the phone. Disable dynamic system notification to avoid the problem.
strings.prefTweakKeepDisplayOnDescription: Do not turn off the screen after inactivity
strings.prefTweakMasterSyncOffDescription: After the takeoff master sync will be disabled (i.e. no new emails, or contacts synchronization during the fly). When you quit XCTrack, sync state will be restored. Saves battery and data transfers. Livetracking won't be affected.
strings.prefTweakMutePhoneDescription: After the takeoff phone notifications (incoming call, SMS etc.) will be muted. On landing the sound settings will be restored. XCTrack notifications will stay audible.
strings.prefTweakRejectCallsDescription2: When flying, incoming phone call will be rejected automatically after few seconds.
strings.prefTweakVolumePctDescription: Set automatically, or by clicking the Crank up volume widget.
strings.prefTweakVolumeUp2: Turn up the volume on startup
strings.prefTweakVolumeUpDescription2: Set event sound volume to a pre-set value on XCTrack startup
strings.safeSkyDescription: SafeSky is a flight information service improving VFR situation awareness. By broadcasting your location, you help ensure that other aircraft can see you, and contribute to a safer sky for everyone.
strings.safeskyAnonymousDescription: In anonymous mode no call-sign is registered with SafeSky. By default, XContest username is provided as a call-sign.
